Fact.Name: Work-requirements conditional-minor age maximum
Fact.Description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the SNAP general work requirement exemption for a person age sixteen (16) or seventeen (17) who is not the head of household, is attending school, or is enrolled in an Employment and Training Program on at least a half-time basis (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Exempt from work requirements due to age
Fact.Description: Whether this member is exempt from SNAP general work requirements because they are age fifteen (15) or younger, age sixty (60) or older, or age sixteen (16) or seventeen (17) and either not the head of household, attending school, or enrolled in an Employment and Training Program on at least a half-time basis (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Applying for or receiving unemployment insurance benefits
Fact.Description: Whether this member is applying for or receiving Unemployment Insurance Benefits (UIB), including a person denied UIB who is appealing the decision, for purposes of the SNAP general work requirement exemption (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Regular participant in drug or alcohol treatment
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a regular participant in a drug or alcohol treatment or rehabilitation program for purposes of the SNAP general work requirement exemption (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Complying with Colorado Works or refugee services work program
Fact.Description: Whether this member is subject to and complying with Colorado Works (CW) or the Colorado Refugee Services Program (CRSP) work programs for purposes of the SNAP general work requirement exemption (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Meets general work requirement exception
Fact.Description: Whether this member meets a SNAP general work requirement exemption: qualifying age, responsibility for the care of a dependent child under six (6) or incapacitated person, physical or mental unfitness for employment, at-least-half-time student enrollment, qualifying employment or self-employment, applying for or receiving UIB, regular participation in drug or alcohol treatment or rehabilitation, or complying with CW or CRSP work programs (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Exempt from work requirements due to caregiving
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a parent or other household member responsible for the care of a dependent child under six (6) or an incapacitated person, based on a claimed /caregiverRelationships entry for this caregiver. The dependent-side member does not need to be part of the SNAP household. The claimed relationship selects the single caregiver who receives the exemption when multiple caregivers are listed for the same dependent (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Work-requirements care exemption dependent child age limit
Fact.Description: Upper bound (exclusive) on the age of a dependent child whose care can qualify one parent or other household member for the SNAP work-requirements exemption: a dependent child under age six (6) (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Exempt from work requirements due to student enrollment
Fact.Description: Whether this member is exempt from SNAP work requirements because they are enrolled at least half-time, as defined by the educational facility, in an accredited school, training program, or institution of higher education. Students who are eligible for SNAP remain exempt during normal periods of class attendance and school breaks; persons enrolled less than half-time, or with an enrollment-status break due to graduation, expulsion, suspension, dropping out, or not intending to register for the next normal school term other than summer, do not qualify for this exemption. A student enrolled in an institution of higher education must also meet SNAP student-eligibility requirements to receive SNAP (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Work-requirements employment exemption hours per week
Fact.Description: Minimum hours per week for the SNAP work-requirement employment exemption: employed or self-employed individuals qualify when working at least thirty (30) hours per week or when receiving weekly earnings at least equal to the federal minimum wage multiplied by thirty (30) hours (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Work-requirements employment exemption monthly earnings limit
Fact.Description: Monthly earnings threshold for the SNAP work-requirement employment exemption, equal to the federal minimum wage hourly rate multiplied by thirty (30) hours and the weekly-to-monthly conversion multiplier (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Exempt from work requirements due to employment
Fact.Description: Whether this member is exempt from SNAP work requirements because the member is employed or self-employed for a total of thirty (30) or more hours per week, or has non-exempt earned income at least equal to the federal minimum wage multiplied by thirty (30) hours and converted to a monthly amount (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Work-requirements total job hours per week
Fact.Description: The total average hours per week this member works across employed or self-employed jobs that are paid at least the federal minimum wage. A total of at least thirty (30) such hours per week can qualify the member for the SNAP work-requirement employment exemption (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Work-requirements federal-minimum-wage job hours per week
Fact.Description: The total average hours per week this member works across jobs paid at least the federal minimum wage, including self-employment jobs where earnings after allowable business expenses are deducted are at least equal to the federal minimum wage for the hours worked. These hours are added together to determine whether weekly earnings meet the thirty (30) hour federal-minimum-wage threshold for the SNAP work-requirement employment exemption (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Disqualified for failure to cooperate with QA division
Fact.Description: Whether this member has been disqualified for failure to cooperate with the state quality assurance division (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Physically or mentally unfit for employment for student eligibility
Fact.Description: Whether this member is physically or mentally unfit for employment for purposes of the SNAP student eligibility exemption. This student-specific flag is separate from the work-requirements unfitness determination so the two policy contexts can be captured independently (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.306.1).

Fact.Name: Physically or mentally unfit for employment for work requirements
Fact.Description: Whether this member is physically or mentally unfit for employment for purposes of SNAP work requirements. Examples include persons experiencing homelessness, persons recently released from an institution, persons with disabilities including self-declared temporary conditions preventing successful participation in work activities, persons receiving temporary or permanent disability benefits from government or private sources, persons participating in vocational rehabilitation, persons applying for or appealing SSI benefits, persons unable to maintain employment, and persons impacted by domestic violence (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Recently released from an institution
Fact.Description: Whether this member was recently released from an institution, which is an example of being physically or mentally unfit for employment for SNAP work-requirements purposes (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Has self-declared temporary condition preventing work activities
Fact.Description: Whether this member has a self-declared temporary condition that would prevent successful participation in work activities, which is an example of being physically or mentally unfit for employment for SNAP work-requirements purposes (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Receives temporary or permanent disability benefits
Fact.Description: Whether this member receives temporary or permanent disability benefits issued by government or private sources, which is an example of being physically or mentally unfit for employment for SNAP work-requirements purposes (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Is participating in vocational rehabilitation
Fact.Description: Whether this member is participating in vocational rehabilitation, which is an example of being physically or mentally unfit for employment for SNAP work-requirements purposes (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Is applying for or appealing SSI benefits
Fact.Description: Whether this member is applying for and/or appealing Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits, which is an example of being physically or mentally unfit for employment for SNAP work-requirements purposes (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Is work-requirement disabled
Fact.Description: Whether this member meets the disability-related examples of being physically or mentally unfit for employment for SNAP work-requirements purposes: a person with disabilities as defined in 4.100, including but not limited to self-declared temporary conditions that would prevent successful participation in work activities, receipt of temporary or permanent disability benefits issued by government or private sources, participation in vocational rehabilitation, or applying for and/or appealing SSI benefits (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Is unable to maintain employment
Fact.Description: Whether this member is unable to maintain employment, which is an example of being physically or mentally unfit for employment for SNAP work-requirements purposes (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Is impacted by domestic violence
Fact.Description: Whether this member is impacted by domestic violence, which is an example of being physically or mentally unfit for employment for SNAP work-requirements purposes (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Has other valid reason for work-requirements unfitness
Fact.Description: Whether this member has another valid reason, not otherwise listed, for being physically or mentally unfit for employment for SNAP work-requirements purposes. The listed examples of unfitness are not exhaustive (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.310).

Fact.Name: Enrolled in Employment and Training Program
Fact.Description: Whether this member is enrolled in the Employment and Training Program (Employment First/EF), a program operated by the Department of Human Services consisting of work, training, education, work experience, and/or job search activities designed to help clients obtain gainful employment (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: In on-the-job training
Fact.Description: Whether this member is receiving on-the-job training (OJT), training provided to an employee after he or she is hired, designed for individuals who do not have the necessary work experience required for the job (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is already participating in another household
Fact.Description: Whether this member is already receiving SNAP benefits as part of another SNAP household or in another state in the same calendar month (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Resident of a shelter for battered women and children
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a resident of a public or private nonprofit residential facility that serves battered women and their children (10 CCR 2506-1)

Fact.Name: Disqualified for participating in another household
Fact.Description: Whether this member is disqualified because they are already participating in another SNAP household in the same month. Residents of a shelter for battered women and children are exempt from this restriction (10 CCR 2506-1)

Fact.Name: Disqualified for felony conviction non-compliance
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a person with a felony conviction who is not in compliance with the terms of their sentence and was convicted as an adult for conduct that occurred after February 7, 2014 for any of the following crimes: aggravated sexual abuse under Section 2241 of Title 18, United States Code; murder under Section 1111 of Title 18, United States Code; an offense under Chapter 110 of Title 18, United States Code; a federal or state offense involving sexual assault, as defined in Section 40002(a) of the Violence Against Women Act of 1994 (42 U.S.C. 13925(a)); or an offense under state law determined by the attorney general to be substantially similar to the foregoing (10 CCR 2506-1)

Fact.Name: Disqualified for living in a boarding house or institution
Fact.Description: Whether this member is disqualified because they are a resident of a commercial or noncommercial boarding house or an institution that has not been authorized by FNS to accept SNAP benefits, and they do not qualify for an exemption under Section 4.304.41 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.304.4)

Fact.Name: Disqualified for parole or probation violation
Fact.Description: Whether this member is disqualified as a parole or probation violator. An impartial party designated by the agency must determine that the individual violated a condition of probation or parole imposed under federal or state law, and that federal, state, or local law enforcement authorities are actively seeking the individual to enforce those conditions. Active pursuit is established when a law enforcement agency informs the local office it intends to enforce an outstanding felony warrant or arrest the individual for a probation or parole violation within 20 days of submitting a request for information about the individual; presents a felony arrest warrant as provided in 4.304.4, B, 1; or states it intends to enforce an outstanding felony warrant or arrest the individual for a probation or parole violation within 30 days of the date of a request from a local office about a specific outstanding felony warrant or probation or parole violation (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.304.4)

Fact.Name: Is pregnant
Fact.Description: Whether this member is pregnant for purposes of the ABAWD exemption from the ABAWD work requirement (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.311.1).

Fact.Name: Is veteran
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a veteran for purposes of the ABAWD exemption from the ABAWD work requirement (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.311.1).

Fact.Name: Was in foster care on 18th birthday
Fact.Description: Whether this member was in foster care on their eighteenth (18th) birthday for purposes of the ABAWD exemption for individuals aged twenty-four (24) years and younger (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.311.1).

Fact.Name: Exempt under ABAWD waiver
Fact.Description: Whether this member is exempt from the ABAWD work requirement under a waiver approved by USDA FNS (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.311.1).

Fact.Name: Exempt under Colorado ABAWD state exemption
Fact.Description: Whether this member is exempt from the ABAWD work requirement using a Colorado-defined state exemption identified in the current SNAP Employment and Training State Plan (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.311.1).

Fact.Name: ABAWD foster care exemption maximum age
Fact.Description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the ABAWD exemption for individuals aged twenty-four (24) years and younger and in foster care on their eighteenth (18th) birthday (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.311.1).

Fact.Name: Young adult foster care ABAWD exempt
Fact.Description: Whether this member is aged twenty-four (24) years or younger and was in foster care on their eighteenth (18th) birthday for purposes of the ABAWD exemption from the ABAWD work requirement (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.311.1).

Fact.Name: Is ABAWD exempt
Fact.Description: Whether this member meets an ABAWD exemption from the ABAWD work requirement by being exempt from the general work requirements, pregnant, experiencing homelessness, a veteran, aged twenty-four (24) years or younger and in foster care on their eighteenth (18th) birthday, exempt under a USDA FNS waiver, or exempt under a Colorado-defined state exemption in the current SNAP Employment and Training State Plan (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.311.1).

Fact.Name: ABAWD countable months limit
Fact.Description: The number of countable months an ABAWD may accrue within a thirty-six (36) month window before being disqualified (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: ABAWD work requirement hours per week
Fact.Description: Minimum weekly hours needed to fulfill the ABAWD work requirement through work, a qualifying work program, or a combination of work and a qualifying work program: twenty (20) hours per week (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Average ABAWD work hours per week
Fact.Description: This member's average weekly ABAWD work hours from jobs classified as compensated work, in-kind work, or unpaid work verified by the provider of the unpaid work. This average is used for both the twenty (20) hours per week threshold and the eighty (80) hours per month averaged-monthly threshold (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: ABAWD work program hours per week
Fact.Description: This member's weekly hours participating in and complying with a qualifying ABAWD work program, including a CDHS-operated or supervised employment and training program other than job search or job-search training, a WIOA program, or a Trade Act Section 236 program (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Participates in Colorado Workfare
Fact.Description: Whether this member is participating in and complying with the Colorado Workfare program for purposes of fulfilling the ABAWD work requirement (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Meets ABAWD work requirement
Fact.Description: Whether this member fulfills the ABAWD work requirement by working at least twenty (20) average hours per week (including work averaged monthly), participating in and complying with a qualifying work program for at least twenty (20) average hours per week (including participation averaged monthly), combining work and qualifying work-program participation to reach that threshold, or participating in and complying with the Colorado Workfare program (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Is ABAWD not meeting work requirement or exemption
Fact.Description: Whether this member is an ABAWD who is not meeting the ABAWD work requirement and does not meet an ABAWD exemption from those requirements (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1; 4.311.1).

Fact.Name: Exceeded ABAWD countable months limit
Fact.Description: Whether this member is an ABAWD who has accrued at least the limit of countable months without meeting an exemption or ABAWD work requirements (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: E-EBT minimum payment
Fact.Description: The minimum Energy Electronic Benefit Transfer (E-EBT) fuel assistance payment that qualifies a SNAP household for the heating and cooling standard utility allowance (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Excess medical deduction
Fact.Description: A deduction from a household's total gross income applied when a person with a disability or a person aged sixty (60) and older has medical expenses over a specified monthly amount (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1). Placeholder.

Fact.Name: Substantial lottery or gambling winnings threshold
Fact.Description: A cash prize won in a single game, before taxes or other amounts are withheld, that is equal to or greater than this threshold counts as substantial lottery or gambling winnings. The threshold equals the resource limit for persons aged sixty (60) and older and persons with disabilities (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1). Placeholder.

Fact.Name: Largest lottery or gambling winnings this month
Fact.Description: The largest portion of substantial lottery or gambling winnings allocated to any member who is part of the SNAP household in a single lottery or gambling game during the month received; those winnings are counted as unearned income in that month (10 CCR 2506-1). Placeholder because the factgraph engine does not currently support collection maximum aggregation.

Fact.Name: Has substantial lottery or gambling winnings this month
Fact.Description: Whether the household's largest single-game lottery or gambling cash prize during the month equals or exceeds the substantial lottery or gambling winnings threshold. Such winnings from an individual will disqualify the entire SNAP household from eligibility in the month the winnings are received (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.206).

Fact.Name: Had previous substantial lottery or gambling winnings
Fact.Description: Whether the SNAP household previously lost eligibility because a member received substantial lottery or gambling winnings. The next time such a household reapplies and is certified for SNAP after losing eligibility, the household must be considered under Standard Eligibility (SE) guidelines; after receiving SNAP as an SE household, the household will be re-evaluated for categorical eligibility at the next eligible certification period (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.206).

Fact.Name: Exempt income
Fact.Description: Income that is exempt from consideration when determining eligibility for SNAP (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1). Placeholder.

Fact.Name: Non-exempt earned income
Fact.Description: This member's monthly earned income after any per-income exempt amount has been subtracted from each income entry before monthly conversion (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1; 4.403; 4.405).

Fact.Name: Unearned income
Fact.Description: This member's unearned income (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1; 4.404), including monthly income entries whose source is treated as unearned income and this member's post-exemption sponsor income. SponsorPayments income entries are excluded from the direct income-entry sum because /members/*/sponsorIncome separately applies the sponsor deeming rules and actual-money-paid comparison.

Fact.Name: Unearned income (including sponsor income)
Fact.Description: This member's unearned income for the indigent-non-citizen determination (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, E, 4; 4.404). Mirrors /members/*/unearnedIncome but points at /members/*/deemedSponsorIncome — the raw per-non-citizen deemed share — instead of /members/*/sponsorIncome, so the indigence check uses sponsor income before the 4.000.1, E exemptions are applied and avoids cycling through /members/*/sponsorIncomeAndResourcesDoNotApply.

Fact.Name: Total self-employment income
Fact.Description: The household's total income received from self-operated businesses or enterprises in which the individual retains control over work or services offered and assumes the necessary business risks and expenses connected with the operation of the business (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Liquid resources
Fact.Description: Assets such as cash on hand or assets that can be easily converted to cash such as money in checking or savings accounts, saving certificates, or stocks and bonds (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Non-liquid resources
Fact.Description: The value of this member's non-liquid resources, such as personal effects, household goods, vehicles, buildings, land, and other real property (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Resources
Fact.Description: This member's total countable resources, the sum of liquid resources, non-liquid resources, and any sponsor resources deemed to this member as a sponsored non-citizen (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Gross income
Fact.Description: The total of all non-exempt earned and unearned income added together before any deduction or disregard is considered (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Gross income (including sponsor income)
Fact.Description: This member's gross income with /members/*/unearnedIncomeWithSponsorIncome standing in for /members/*/unearnedIncome — i.e., using /members/*/deemedSponsorIncome (the raw per-non-citizen deemed share, NOT the post-exemption /members/*/sponsorIncome) as the sponsor-income contribution. Used to assess indigent non-citizen status (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, E, 4) without cycling through /members/*/sponsorIncomeAndResourcesDoNotApply, since indigence itself feeds into that exemption umbrella.

Fact.Name: Net income test rate
Fact.Description: The percentage of the federal poverty level used as the net income test threshold (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Net income threshold
Fact.Description: One hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for the household's size, under which a household's income must fall after all allowable deductions are considered (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Net income
Fact.Description: The household's income after all allowable deductions are considered, used for the net income test (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1). Placeholder.

Fact.Name: Meets net income test
Fact.Description: Whether the household's net income falls at or below one hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for the household's size (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Participates in Commodity Food Distribution Program
Fact.Description: Whether the household is on an Indian reservation and participating in the Commodity Food Distribution Program for the current period. Participation must be limited to either the Commodity Food Distribution Program or SNAP, not both (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.304.4).

Fact.Name: Lives in application county or district
Fact.Description: Whether the household lives in the county or district in which they make application for the Program (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.303).

Fact.Name: Has nearby county/district filing arrangement
Fact.Description: Whether the local office has made arrangements to allow this household to file an application in a nearby specified county/district office (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.303).

Fact.Name: Meets residency requirement
Fact.Description: Whether the household meets the residency requirement: applicants shall live in the county or district in which they make application for the Program, unless the local office has made arrangements to allow particular households to file an application in a nearby specified county/district office (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.303).

Fact.Name: Meets non-financial criteria
Fact.Description: Whether the household meets the set of rules other than those governing the household's gross and net income and resource standards (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Is experiencing homelessness
Fact.Description: Whether this member lacks a fixed and regular nighttime residence or whose primary residence is a supervised shelter designed for temporary accommodations; a halfway house or similar facility that provides temporary residence; a place not designed for or ordinarily used as regular sleeping accommodations for human beings; or a temporary accommodation in the residence of another individual for ninety (90) days or less (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is fleeing felon
Fact.Description: Whether this member is fleeing to avoid prosecution or custody for a crime, or an attempt to commit a crime, that would be classified as a felony under a state or federal law (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is migrant farm worker
Fact.Description: Whether this member travels away from home on a regular basis to follow the flow of seasonal agricultural work (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is striker
Fact.Description: Whether this member is involved in a strike or other concerted stoppage of work by employees, including a stoppage by reason of the expiration of a collective bargaining agreement and any concerted slowdown or other concerted interruption of operations by employees (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Was eligible for SNAP the day before the strike
Fact.Description: Whether the household containing this striking member was eligible for SNAP the day before the strike. A household containing a striker is only eligible for SNAP if the household was eligible the day before the strike and is otherwise eligible at the time of the strike (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305).

Fact.Name: Was exempt from work registration the day before the strike
Fact.Description: Whether this striking member was exempt from work registration the day before the strike, such as the caretaker of a child under six (6) years of age, other than persons exempt solely on the ground that they were employed. Households where the striking member was so exempt are not subject to the striker eligibility restriction (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, A and D).

Fact.Name: Is ineligible striker
Fact.Description: Whether this member is an ineligible striker. A household containing a striking member shall not be eligible for SNAP unless the household was eligible for the Program the day before the strike and is otherwise eligible at the time of the strike. Households where the striking member was exempt from work registration the day before the strike (other than persons exempt solely on the ground that they were employed) are not subject to these provisions (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305).

Fact.Name: Student enrollment status options
Fact.Description: Options describing a member's enrollment status in an institution of higher education — an institution that normally requires a high school diploma or equivalency certificate for a student to enroll, such as a college, university, or vocational or technical school: full time (a school schedule equivalent to a full-time curriculum as defined by the institution of higher education the person is attending), at least half time but less than full time, or less than half time / not enrolled (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Student enrollment status
Fact.Description: This member's enrollment status in an institution of higher education — an institution that normally requires a high school diploma or equivalency certificate for a student to enroll, such as a college, university, or vocational or technical school: full time (a school schedule equivalent to a full-time curriculum as defined by the institution of higher education the person is attending), at least half time but less than full time, or less than half time / not enrolled (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Enrolled in post high school education
Fact.Description: Whether this member is enrolled in a college, university, or post-high school level technical or vocational school (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is U.S. citizen
Fact.Description: Whether this member is considered a U.S. citizen for SNAP: a person born in the United States or in the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, or the Mariana Islands; a person who has become a citizen through the naturalization process; a person born outside the United States to at least one (1) U.S. citizen parent; or a child under eighteen (18) years of age adopted or born outside the U.S. with a parent who is a U.S. citizen, who has been admitted as a lawful permanent resident, and is in the legal and physical custody of a parent who is a U.S. citizen (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305).

Fact.Name: Is non-citizen
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a non-citizen — anyone who is not a U.S. citizen. Qualified non-citizens and certain groups of non-citizens who are not qualified are eligible for SNAP participation under certain conditions; some qualified non-citizens must also meet an additional condition to be eligible. Each category of qualified non-citizen stands alone for purposes of determining eligibility (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B).

Fact.Name: Is non-citizen national
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a non-citizen national of the United States — an individual born in an outlying possession of the United States (either American Samoa or Swain's Island) on or after the date the U.S. acquired the possession, or a person whose parents are U.S. non-citizen nationals. Non-citizen nationals have eligibility for SNAP as U.S. citizens (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305)

Fact.Name: Is lawful permanent resident
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a non-citizen legally admitted into the United States to reside on a permanent basis (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is parolee
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a non-citizen granted parole into the United States, as described in 8 U.S.C. 1182(d)(5) and 8 C.F.R. 212.5 (2019). Parole does not constitute a formal admission to the United States and confers temporary status only, requiring parolees to leave when the conditions supporting their parole cease to exist (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is asylee
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a non-citizen granted asylum, included as a qualified non-citizen for SNAP under 7 C.F.R. 273.4(a)(5), (6)(1) (2019) (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is refugee
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a non-citizen admitted as a refugee, included as a qualified non-citizen for SNAP under 7 C.F.R. 273.4(a)(5), (6)(1) (2019) (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Has withholding of deportation or removal
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a non-citizen granted withholding of deportation or removal, included as a qualified non-citizen for SNAP under 7 C.F.R. 273.4(a)(5), (6)(1) (2019) (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is conditional entrant
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a non-citizen admitted as a conditional entrant, included as a qualified non-citizen for SNAP under 7 C.F.R. 273.4(a)(5), (6)(1) (2019) (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is Cuban or Haitian entrant
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a Cuban or Haitian entrant, included as a qualified non-citizen for SNAP under 7 C.F.R. 273.4(a)(5), (6)(1) (2019) (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is battered immigrant
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a battered immigrant, included as a qualified non-citizen for SNAP under 7 C.F.R. 273.4(a)(5), (6)(1) (2019) (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is victim of severe trafficking
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a non-citizen victim of a severe form of trafficking, included as a qualified non-citizen for SNAP under 7 C.F.R. 273.4(a)(5), (6)(1) (2019) (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is Amerasian
Fact.Description: Whether this member is an Amerasian eligible for SNAP under 8 U.S.C. 1612, retroactive to August 22, 1996 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B).

Fact.Name: Is Iraqi or Afghan special immigrant
Fact.Description: Whether this member is an Iraqi or Afghan national granted special immigrant status under 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(27) for having worked on behalf of the U.S. Government in Iraq or Afghanistan. Under the Department of Defense Appropriations Act of 2010 (P.L. 111-118, Section 8120), Special Immigrant Visa holders are eligible for SNAP to the same extent and for the same period as refugees (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B).

Fact.Name: Is qualified non-citizen without additional condition
Fact.Description: Whether this member is in a qualified non-citizen status that is eligible for SNAP participation indefinitely from the date the non-citizen obtains qualified non-citizen status or enters the U.S. in a qualifying status, without having to meet an additional condition: refugees admitted under 8 U.S.C. 1157, victims of trafficking under the Trafficking Victims Protection Act of 2000, asylees granted asylum under Section 208 of the INA, non-citizens whose deportation or removal is being withheld under 8 U.S.C. 1224(H) or 8 U.S.C. 1231(B)(3), Cuban or Haitian entrants under 8 U.S.C. 1522(E), Amerasians under 8 U.S.C. 1612, and Iraqi or Afghan Special Immigrants under 8 U.S.C. 1101(A)(27) (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 2, a).

Fact.Name: Is qualified non-citizen with additional condition
Fact.Description: Whether this member is in a qualified non-citizen status that is required to meet an additional condition (see Section 4.305, B, 3) to be eligible for participation in the Program: Lawfully Admitted for Permanent Residence (LPRs) under the Immigration and Nationality Act, non-citizens paroled into the United States under 8 U.S.C. 1182(d)(5) for at least one (1) year, non-citizens granted conditional entry pursuant to 8 U.S.C. 1153(a)(7) as in effect before April 1, 1980, and non-citizens who have been battered or subjected to extreme cruelty in the U.S. by a family member with whom the non-citizen resides (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 2, b).

Fact.Name: Is qualified non-citizen
Fact.Description: Whether this member meets the definition of "qualified alien" under 7 C.F.R. 273.4(a)(5), (6)(1) (2019) for SNAP purposes: lawful permanent residents, asylees, refugees, parolees, individuals granted withholding of deportation or removal, conditional entrants, Cuban or Haitian entrants, battered immigrants, and non-citizen victims of a severe form of trafficking. This term is not itself an immigration status; qualified non-citizens are not automatically eligible for SNAP and must meet all other eligibility requirements (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B).

Fact.Name: Is American Indian born abroad
Fact.Description: Whether this member is an American Indian born abroad in Canada living in the U.S. under Section 289 of the INA, or a non-citizen member of a federally recognized Indian tribe under Section 4(e) of the Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act (25 U.S.C. 450(B)(E)) who is recognized as eligible for the special programs and services provided by the U.S. to Indians because of their status as Indians. This provision covers Native Americans entitled to cross the U.S. border between Canada and/or Mexico, including but not limited to the St. Regis Band of the Mohawk in New York State, the Micmac (also known as Mi'kmaq) in Maine, the Abenaki in Vermont, and the Kickapoo in Texas (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B).

Fact.Name: Is Hmong or Highland Laotian Tribal Member
Fact.Description: Whether this member is an individual lawfully residing in the U.S. who was a member of a Hmong or Highland Laotian tribe that rendered assistance to U.S. personnel by taking part in a military or rescue operation during the Vietnam era (August 5, 1964 – May 7, 1975); the spouse or surviving (not remarried) spouse of such a tribal member; an unmarried dependent child of such a tribal member who is under the age of eighteen (18) or a full-time student under the age of twenty-two (22); an unmarried child under the age of eighteen (18) or a full-time student under the age of twenty-two (22) of a deceased Hmong or Highland Laotian Tribal Member, provided the child was dependent upon them at the time of the tribal member's death; or an unmarried child with disabilities age eighteen (18) or older if the child had a disability and was dependent on the tribal member prior to the child's eighteenth (18th) birthday. For purposes of this category, "child" means the legally adopted or biological child of the Hmong or Highland Laotian Tribal Member (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B).

Fact.Name: Is eligible non-qualified non-citizen
Fact.Description: Whether this member is in a class of non-citizens that is not defined as a qualified non-citizen status but is potentially eligible for SNAP participation without having to meet an additional condition (see Section 4.305, B, 3): certain American Indians born abroad, and Hmong or Highland Laotian Tribal Members. All other classes of non-citizens that are not in a qualified status are not eligible for participation in SNAP (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 2).

Fact.Name: Non-citizen child age limit (additional-condition case)
Fact.Description: Upper bound (exclusive) on a non-citizen's age for the children-under-eighteen additional condition (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 3, c): a non-citizen under eighteen (18) years of age in a qualified non-citizen status who lawfully resides in the U.S. satisfies the additional-condition requirement. When the non-citizen turns eighteen (18), non-citizen eligibility shall be reviewed.

Fact.Name: Qualified non-citizen residence years threshold
Fact.Description: Lower bound (inclusive) on the number of years a non-citizen must have lived in the U.S. in a qualified non-citizen status to satisfy the five-year residence additional condition (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 3, a).

Fact.Name: Qualified years in the U.S.
Fact.Description: The number of years this non-citizen has lived in the U.S. in a qualified non-citizen status. The waiting period begins on the date the non-citizen obtains status as a qualified non-citizen or enters the U.S. in a qualifying status (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 3, a).

Fact.Name: Has five years in a qualified non-citizen status
Fact.Description: Whether this non-citizen has lived in the U.S. in a qualified non-citizen status for five (5) years. The five (5) year waiting period begins on the date the non-citizen obtains status as a qualified non-citizen or enters the U.S. in a qualifying status (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 3, a).

Fact.Name: Qualifying work quarters threshold
Fact.Description: Lower bound (inclusive) on the number of qualifying work quarters a non-citizen must have to satisfy the work-quarters additional condition (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 3, b).

Fact.Name: Qualifying work quarters
Fact.Description: The total number of qualifying work quarters credited to this non-citizen under Title II of the Social Security Act. The sum may include the non-citizen's own quarters, quarters credited from the work of a parent while the non-citizen was under eighteen (18), and quarters credited from the work of the non-citizen's spouse, subject to the restrictions in 4.305, B, 3, b (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 3, b).

Fact.Name: Has forty qualifying work quarters
Fact.Description: Whether this non-citizen has satisfied the forty (40) qualifying work quarters additional condition, as defined under Title II of the Social Security Act. The sum may include the non-citizen's own quarters, quarters credited from the work of a parent while the non-citizen was under eighteen (18), and quarters credited from the work of the non-citizen's spouse, subject to the restrictions in 4.305, B, 3, b (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 3, b).

Fact.Name: Born on or before August 22, 1931 and lawfully resided in the U.S. on August 22, 1996
Fact.Description: Whether this non-citizen was born on or before August 22, 1931 and lawfully resided in the U.S. on August 22, 1996 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 3, e).

Fact.Name: Has qualifying military connection
Fact.Description: Whether this qualified non-citizen has a qualifying military connection: an individual lawfully residing in a state on active duty (other than training) in the military, excluding national guard; an honorably discharged veteran (as defined in Section 101 of Title 38, U.S.C.) whose discharge is not because of immigration status and who fulfills the minimum active-duty service requirements, including an individual who died in active military, naval, or air service; or the spouse, un-remarried surviving spouse, or unmarried dependent child of such a person, as further defined in 4.305, B, 3, f (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 3, f).

Fact.Name: Meets additional condition for non-citizen eligibility
Fact.Description: Whether this member, who is in a qualified non-citizen status as outlined in subsection 4.305, B, 1, satisfies at least one of the additional conditions listed in 4.305, B, 3, required for eligibility for participation in the Program: five (5) years of residence in a qualified non-citizen status, forty (40) qualifying work quarters, under eighteen (18) years of age, a person with disabilities, born on or before August 22, 1931 and lawfully residing in the U.S. on August 22, 1996, or a qualifying military connection (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B, 3).

Fact.Name: Is eligible non-citizen
Fact.Description: Whether this non-citizen member is eligible for SNAP participation: they are a qualified non-citizen who is either not required to meet an additional condition (4.305, B, 2, a) or meets one of the additional conditions in 4.305, B, 3, OR they fall in one of the classes of non-qualified non-citizens eligible for participation (4.305, B, 2). Each category stands alone for purposes of determining eligibility (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.305, B).

Fact.Name: Is sponsored non-citizen
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a non-citizen lawfully admitted for permanent residence into the United States who has been sponsored by an individual for entry into the country, derived from whether /members/*/sponsorId is set on this member (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Sponsor earned income deduction rate
Fact.Description: The fraction of the sponsor and sponsor's spouse's earned income subtracted from their combined gross income when deeming sponsor income to a sponsored non-citizen. Twenty percent (20%) per 10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, a.

Fact.Name: Sponsor and spouse gross income
Fact.Description: The combined gross income of this sponsored non-citizen's sponsor and the sponsor's spouse, used in sponsor income deeming (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D). The spouse's income is counted even if the sponsor and spouse were married after the signing of the affidavit of support.

Fact.Name: Sponsor and spouse non-exempt earned income
Fact.Description: The combined non-exempt earned income of this sponsored non-citizen's sponsor and the sponsor's spouse, used in the twenty percent (20%) earned-income reduction in sponsor income deeming (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, a).

Fact.Name: Sponsor and spouse dependent count
Fact.Description: The number of other people who are claimed or could be claimed for federal income tax purposes as a dependent by this sponsored non-citizen's sponsor or the sponsor's spouse, used to size the sponsor's tax household in sponsor income deeming (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, b).

Fact.Name: Sponsor household size
Fact.Description: The size of this sponsored non-citizen's sponsor's tax household, equal to one (the sponsor) plus one if the sponsor has a spouse plus the number of other people claimed or who could be claimed as a dependent for federal income tax purposes by the sponsor or the sponsor's spouse (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, b).

Fact.Name: Sponsor household federal poverty level
Fact.Description: The federal poverty level for a household equal in size to ../sponsorHouseholdSize (this sponsored non-citizen's sponsor's tax household), used in computing the sponsor gross income eligibility limit (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, b). Placeholder writable until the per-size FPL schedule is wired up.

Fact.Name: Sponsor gross income eligibility limit
Fact.Description: The SNAP monthly gross income eligibility limit for a household equal in size to this sponsored non-citizen's sponsor, the sponsor's spouse, and any other person who is claimed or could be claimed by the sponsor or the sponsor's spouse for federal income tax purposes as a dependent, subtracted from the combined sponsor and spouse gross income (after the twenty percent earned-income reduction) in sponsor income deeming (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, b). One hundred thirty percent (130%) of the FPL for the sponsor's tax household size.

Fact.Name: Sponsor and spouse deemed income
Fact.Description: The combined monthly income of this sponsored non-citizen's sponsor and the sponsor's spouse after the two policy deductions in sponsor income deeming: their combined gross income reduced by twenty percent (20%) of their combined earned income (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, a) and by the SNAP monthly gross income eligibility limit for the sponsor's tax household (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, b). This is the per-sponsor amount, before any division among multiple sponsored non-citizens.

Fact.Name: Sponsored non-citizen count in household
Fact.Description: The number of sponsored non-citizens this member sponsors who are themselves members of this SNAP household, derived as the count of /members whose sponsorId references this member (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, c).

Fact.Name: Sponsored non-citizen count outside household
Fact.Description: The number of sponsored non-citizens this member sponsors who are not members of this SNAP household, as demonstrated by a sponsored non-citizen in this household to the local office's satisfaction (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, c).

Fact.Name: Sponsored non-citizen count
Fact.Description: The total number of sponsored non-citizens this member sponsors, across all households — the sum of the in-household and outside-household counts. Used to divide the deemed sponsor income among the sponsored non-citizens when the sponsor has sponsored more than one (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, c).

Fact.Name: Deemed sponsor income
Fact.Description: The monthly sponsor income deemed to this sponsored non-citizen as unearned income, computed as the sponsor and spouse's deemed income (after the 20% earned-income reduction and the sponsor's tax-household gross income limit) divided among all non-citizens the sponsor sponsors (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 2, c). Zero for members without a sponsor so the value can be added into /members/*/unearnedIncome without making it incomplete for non-sponsored members.

Fact.Name: Actual money paid by sponsor
Fact.Description: The actual monthly money paid to this sponsored non-citizen by the sponsor or the sponsor's spouse, derived as the sum of monthlyAmount across /incomes entries belonging to this member with type SponsorPayments. Used to determine whether any excess over the deemed sponsor income must be added as additional income to the non-citizen (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 4).

Fact.Name: Effective deemed sponsor income
Fact.Description: The deemed sponsor income share applied to this sponsored non-citizen for SNAP, zeroed when the sponsor income and resource deeming provisions do not apply per 10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, E (see /members/*/sponsorIncomeAndResourcesDoNotApply). Otherwise equal to /members/*/deemedSponsorIncome.

Fact.Name: Sponsor income
Fact.Description: The monthly sponsor income considered for this sponsored non-citizen, equal to the greater of the effective deemed sponsor income share (zeroed when the 4.000.1, E exemptions apply) and the actual money paid by the sponsor or the sponsor's spouse. Per 10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 4, actual money paid is not considered as income unless it exceeds the amount already deemed; when it does, only the excess is added to the considered income, so the total considered equals the actual amount paid.

Fact.Name: Sponsor resource deduction
Fact.Description: The flat dollar amount subtracted from the combined total resources of a sponsored non-citizen's sponsor and the sponsor's spouse when deeming sponsor resources to the non-citizen. One thousand five hundred dollars ($1,500) per 10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 6.

Fact.Name: Sponsor and spouse resources
Fact.Description: The combined total resources (liquid and non-liquid) of this sponsored non-citizen's sponsor and the sponsor's spouse, used in sponsor resource deeming (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 6).

Fact.Name: Sponsor resources
Fact.Description: The sponsor resources considered for this sponsored non-citizen, computed as the combined total resources of the sponsor and the sponsor's spouse reduced by one thousand five hundred dollars ($1,500) and divided among all non-citizens the sponsor sponsors (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, D, 6). Zero for members without a sponsor, and zero when the sponsor income and resource deeming provisions do not apply per 10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, E (see /members/*/sponsorIncomeAndResourcesDoNotApply), so the value can be added into household resources without making it incomplete for non-sponsored members.

Fact.Name: Sponsor
Fact.Description: The household member who executed an affidavit of support (USCIS form I-864A) or another form deemed legally binding by the Department of Homeland Security on behalf of this non-citizen as a condition of the non-citizen's entry or admission into the United States as a permanent resident (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is sponsor
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a sponsor — a person who executed an affidavit(s) of support (INS Form I-864 or I-864A) or another form deemed legally binding by the Department of Homeland Security on behalf of a non-citizen as a condition of the non-citizen's entry or admission to the United States as a permanent resident (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level for 1-person household
Fact.Description: One hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for a 1-person household, effective October 1, 2025 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.401.1).

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level for 2-person household
Fact.Description: One hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for a 2-person household, effective October 1, 2025 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.401.1).

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level for 3-person household
Fact.Description: One hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for a 3-person household, effective October 1, 2025 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.401.1).

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level for 4-person household
Fact.Description: One hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for a 4-person household, effective October 1, 2025 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.401.1).

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level for 5-person household
Fact.Description: One hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for a 5-person household, effective October 1, 2025 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.401.1).

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level for 6-person household
Fact.Description: One hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for a 6-person household, effective October 1, 2025 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.401.1).

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level for 7-person household
Fact.Description: One hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for a 7-person household, effective October 1, 2025 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.401.1).

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level for 8-person household
Fact.Description: One hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for an 8-person household, effective October 1, 2025 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.401.1).

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level per additional person
Fact.Description: The amount added to the 8-person one hundred percent (100%) federal poverty level for each additional household member beyond eight, effective October 1, 2025 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.401.1).

Fact.Name: Federal poverty level
Fact.Description: One hundred percent (100%) of the federal poverty level for the household's size, effective October 1, 2025 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.401.1). Looked up from the household-size schedule, with /fplPerAdditionalPerson added for each member beyond eight.

Fact.Name: Indigent non-citizen FPL rate
Fact.Description: The percentage of the federal poverty level used as the food-and-shelter threshold for determining indigent non-citizen status (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Indigent non-citizen FPL threshold
Fact.Description: One hundred thirty percent (130%) of the federal poverty level for the non-citizen's household size, used to determine indigent non-citizen status (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is indigent non-citizen
Fact.Description: A sponsored non-citizen who, after considering all income and contributions provided by the sponsor and other sources in conjunction with the non-citizen's own income, is unable to obtain food and shelter amounting to one hundred thirty percent (130%) of the federal poverty level for the non-citizen's household size (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1). Determined by comparing /grossIncomeWithSponsorIncome (the SNAP household's combined gross income with each sponsored non-citizen's sponsor income rolled in) to /indigentNonCitizenFplThreshold.

Fact.Name: Is sponsored by organization
Fact.Description: Whether this non-citizen is sponsored by an organization or group as opposed to an individual, which exempts the non-citizen from sponsor income and resource deeming (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, E, 2).

Fact.Name: Is not required to have a sponsor under the INA
Fact.Description: Whether this non-citizen falls into a class that is not required to have a sponsor under the Immigration and Nationality Act, which exempts them from SNAP sponsor income and resource deeming (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, E, 3). Covers refugees (INA § 207), asylees (INA § 208), parolees (INA § 212), Cuban or Haitian entrants (Refugee Education Assistance Act), individuals whose deportation or removal is withheld (INA §§ 243, 241), victims of severe trafficking (Trafficking Victims Protection Act T-visas), Iraqi/Afghan special immigrants (SIV), conditional entrants (INA § 203, pre-April 1, 1980), American Indians born abroad with treaty border-crossing rights, Hmong or Highland Laotian Tribal members, and Amerasian immigrants.

Fact.Name: Sponsor income and resources do not apply
Fact.Description: Whether the SNAP sponsor income and resource deeming provisions do not apply to this sponsored non-citizen (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, E). True when any of the modeled statutory exemptions holds: 1) the non-citizen is a member of the sponsor's SNAP household, 2) sponsored by an organization or group rather than an individual, 3) not required to have a sponsor under the INA (see ../isNotRequiredToHaveSponsorUnderIna), 4) is an indigent non-citizen, 5) is a battered non-citizen, 6) had been sponsored but has since obtained citizenship, or 8) has worked or can receive credit for forty (40) qualifying work quarters. Condition 7 (sponsor has died) is not yet modeled.

Fact.Name: Receives TANF/Colorado Works
Fact.Description: Whether this member receives a cash grant from the Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) or Colorado Works (CW) cash program, also known as Title IV-A of the Social Security Act (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Receives Old Age Pension (OAP)
Fact.Description: Whether this member receives Old Age Pension (OAP) cash assistance (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.206).

Fact.Name: Receives Aid to the Needy Disabled (AND)
Fact.Description: Whether this member receives Aid to the Needy Disabled (AND) cash assistance (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.206).

Fact.Name: Receives Aid to the Blind (AB)
Fact.Description: Whether this member receives Aid to the Blind (AB) cash assistance (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.206).

Fact.Name: Receives Colorado Supplement to SSI
Fact.Description: Whether this member receives the Colorado Supplement to the SSI Grant (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.208.2).

Fact.Name: Receives Adult Financial cash grant
Fact.Description: Whether this member receives an Adult Financial cash grant — Old Age Pension (OAP), Aid to the Needy Disabled (AND), or Aid to the Blind (AB) — or the Colorado Supplement to the SSI Grant (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1; 4.208.2).

Fact.Name: Public assistance amount
Fact.Description: The amount of public assistance (PA) this member receives, as defined in section 26-2-103(7), C.R.S. (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is PA member
Fact.Description: Whether this member receives TANF/Colorado Works or Adult Financial cash grants (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is PA household
Fact.Description: A household that contains only persons who receive TANF/Colorado Works or Adult Financial cash grants (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is Non-PA household
Fact.Description: A household that is not a PA household. County General Assistance (GA), SSI with no Colorado Supplemental payment, and medical-only programs are not considered PA benefits (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1).

Fact.Name: Has level sanction imposed
Fact.Description: Whether a specified period of ineligibility has been imposed against this member for failing to take a required action as part of his or her eligibility for SNAP (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Liquid resources
Fact.Description: The sum of liquid resources across all household members (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Gross income
Fact.Description: The sum of gross income across members who are part of the SNAP household (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Gross income (including sponsor income)
Fact.Description: The SNAP household's combined gross income with each sponsored non-citizen's /members/*/sponsorIncome rolled in, used to assess indigent non-citizen status against one hundred thirty percent (130%) of the federal poverty level (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1, E, 4).

Fact.Name: Expedited service liquid resources threshold
Fact.Description: The maximum liquid resources a household may have (one hundred dollars, $100) to qualify for expedited service under criteria 1 and 2 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Expedited service gross income threshold
Fact.Description: The gross monthly income limit (one hundred fifty dollars, $150) used to qualify for expedited service under criterion 2 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Destitute income new-source threshold
Fact.Description: The amount a new income source must exceed — twenty-five dollars ($25) — to satisfy the destitute-of-income new-source rule (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.406, A, 2-3).

Fact.Name: Destitute income new-source deadline offset days
Fact.Description: The ten (10) calendar-day offset added to the application filing date for initial certification, or to the household's normal issuance cycle date for recertification, when calculating the new-source income deadline for destitute-of-income treatment (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.406, A, 2-3).

Fact.Name: Destitute income new-source deadline date
Fact.Description: The tenth (10th) calendar day after the filing date for initial certification, or the tenth (10th) calendar day after the household's normal issuance cycle for recertification; new-source income counts toward destitute income only if it will not be received by this date (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.406, A, 2-3).

Fact.Name: Destitute income source criteria met
Fact.Description: Whether, after filtering to non-exempt incomes of people who are part of the SNAP household, at least one income counts toward the destitute-income requirement and zero incomes fail to count toward that requirement. Exempt incomes count neither toward nor against this requirement (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.406).

Fact.Name: Benefit month
Fact.Description: The specific calendar month for which the engine is currently calculating benefits and eligibility, used to determine whether the household is in the first month of the certification period for destitute-of-income treatment (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.406).

Fact.Name: Certification period start date
Fact.Description: The official first day of the household's approved initial certification or recertification period, used to determine whether the benefit month is the first month of the certification period for destitute-of-income treatment (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.406).

Fact.Name: Is first month of certification period
Fact.Description: Whether the benefit month is the same calendar month and year as the household's certification period start date; migrant or seasonal farm worker households may be considered destitute of income only for the first month of each certification period (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.406).

Fact.Name: Is destitute of income
Fact.Description: Whether a migrant or seasonal farm worker household is destitute of income for the first month of an initial certification or recertification period. The detailed terminated/new income-source test is represented by /destituteIncomeSourceCriteriaMet for now (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.406).

Fact.Name: Anticipated monthly rent/mortgage and utilities
Fact.Description: The household's anticipated monthly rent or mortgage plus utility costs, using the appropriate utility standard as defined in Section 4.407.31 (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1). Placeholder.

Fact.Name: Is expedited
Fact.Description: Whether the household qualifies for expedited service: (1) liquid resources do not exceed $100 and the household is destitute of income as defined in Section 4.406; (2) liquid resources do not exceed $100 and the household reasonably expects less than $150 of gross monthly income in the calendar month of application; or (3) combined monthly gross income and liquid resources are less than the household's anticipated monthly rent/mortgage and utilities (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1)

Fact.Name: Is disqualified individual
Fact.Description: Whether this member is ineligible to receive SNAP benefits due to disqualification for an Intentional Program Violation/fraud, failure to provide or obtain a SSN, status as an ineligible non-citizen, failure to meet general work requirements, having a level sanction imposed, failure to cooperate with work requirements, failure to cooperate with the state quality assurance division, or as an ABAWD who has received three countable months of SNAP within thirty-six (36) months without meeting an exemption or ABAWD work requirements (10 CCR 2506-1, 4.000.1; 4.310; 4.310.8)
